messages:
alice.s: Pushing a helm upgrade for inference-stack v2.3.7, canary=enabled. Post-upgrade hook job is failing and the release is stuck :grimacing:

brian_r: seeing the same. Hook Job 'migrate-cache-0' CrashLoopBackOff, logs show it can't schedule to GPU nodes.

carol-ops: any recent infra changes? Terraform PR merged this morning that adjusted node labels for GPU nodepools.

dan_oncall: yes, TF rename: `node.k8s.io/gpu` -> `node.k8s.io/gpu-capable` to match cloud provider. Might have caused selector mismatch.

alice.s: oof. The hook Job has nodeSelector `node.k8s.io/gpu: "true"` hardcoded in the hook template. That won't match new labels.

brian_r: quick check output:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n infra -l job-name=migrate-cache-0 -o wide
NAME                          READY   STATUS             NODE                  
migrate-cache-0-abcdef        0/1     CrashLoopBackOff    node-gpu-3            
```
and scheduler events: `0/10 nodes are available: 10 node(s) didn't match node selector.`

carol-ops: confirm TF changed labels on the GPU nodepool last deploy -> running a small script to list nodes and labels.

infra-bot: terraform apply for module/nodepool finished by @carol-ops at 2026-03-18T09:05Z. Changed labels: node.k8s.io/gpu -> node.k8s.io/gpu-capable

emma_deploybot: helm release inference-stack: upgrade reported hooks failed: post-upgrade hook pod migrate-cache-0 failed. Rollback not automatic because canary policy = manual.

dan_oncall: we have two options: patch the hook Job selector to new label and restart the job, or temporarily relabel GPU nodes back to the old key so upgrade completes then perform a coordinated change. Thoughts?

alice.s: prefer patch hook template in chart and re-run helm upgrade asap. But that requires a new chart publish + image tag? The hook Job uses the same image but template fix is trivial. Could we do a quick `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set hooks.migrateCache.nodeSelector.node.k8s.io/gpu-capable=true`? Not sure about the `.` in the key.

brian_r: helm supports `--set-string` but dots are interpreted; better to apply a small kubectl patch to the Job object created by the hook. It's ephemeral but will let the hook finish so the release can proceed.

carol-ops: running patch now: `kubectl patch job migrate-cache-0 -n infra --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/nodeSelector/node.k8s.io~1gpu-capable","value":"true"}]'`

alice.s: nice. Keep an eye on logs.

brian_r: pod rescheduled, now Pending -> Running -> Completed :tada:

emma_deploybot: hook job completed, helm canary step advancing. Release now at 40% traffic.

dan_oncall: follow-up action items: 1) update chart hook template to reference a label config value (hooks.nodeSelectorKey) instead of hardcoding; 2) add a preflight check in our GitOps pipeline to validate nodeSelector against cluster node labels; 3) add a short post-merge step in TF PRs to run a dry-run helm upgrade for affected charts.

carol-ops: created infra ticket INF-1423 for TF label deprecation and added a note to the PR template.

alice.s: I'll open a chart PR with the nodeSelectorKey defaulted to `node.k8s.io/gpu-capable` but keep backward compat by allowing the old key via values. Will also add a smoke hook to verify scheduling.

brian_r: thanks. Putting a short blurb in the release notes that this chart change is required for clusters migrated after the TF label rename.

dan_oncall: closing thread — will monitor canary for 30m. If regressions, rollback. :eyes:
